input.summary: Fix illusory liability cap: base it on all amounts payable under the Agreement in the preceding 12 months, with a USD 1,000,000 floor.
input.comment: [Playbook] As drafted the cap is tied to "Fees", which is defined as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, so the mutual cap is illusory and sits far below our floor of 12 months' charges. We have changed the basis to the greater of all amounts paid or payable under the Agreement in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000; indemnification, confidentiality, data-protection and security obligations remain outside the cap under Section 21.3, which we are happy to leave as is.

ops.oldText: shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim
ops.newText: shall not exceed the greater of (a) all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000
